title: 第七章：开智汤的主药
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

从山洞里出来后，和长老他们回到了议事大厅。赵长老把自己知道的所有事都和他说了一遍。

“苏大人，就如你所见到的一样，我们在这有6千多年了，预言一代代传下来说会有一个姓苏大人带领我们离开这....现在这里就由苏大人做主了”

赵长老在那高兴的和他说着，就好像是现在来了个背锅的人，把自己的位置取代了。

在诺柏的安排下，苏行枫的祖先就是星空戒的掌事人，同时也是一道引子，只有苏家的人才可以开启诺柏设置的机关。而赵长老所说的预言就是诺柏之后，掌事人之事，除了诺柏外在这苏家血脉才是正统。

而赵长老知道两界之事，这也正是每一代长老传承下来的，只是现在苏行枫没有任何修为，无法开启传送阵，所以在一通商量之后赵长老给他定制了一套修炼方案，好让他把修为提高，这样就能

“苏大人，这里面是所有的功法和心法、阵法、炼器术还有一些每代长老留下的修炼随笔.....”

长老自己有一个空间手镯，他把一块玉简递给苏行枫。然后又拿出了一些丹药，并说明各作用。

他拿着这些东西点了点头，现在他也不知道要怎么办，他现在唯有按长老所说，先好好修炼。本来诺柏有自己的传承，但是苏行枫一点修为也没，现在他也得不到那些传承，所以他只能先用长老的这些修炼资源。

“苏大人，长老，苏大人的房子做好了”

亮子按长老说的，在部落里给苏行枫另外盖了一座房子。

“我们去看看吧！”

苏行枫在这和长老聊了这么多事，自己脑袋都快装不下了，正好休息一下把这些事消化一下，在庄平的帮助下，他回到了地面，来到自己的新房子那。

因为考虑到现在他还没有修为，在房子那做了梯子，可以爬上去，他试了一下爬到房子上后，空间很大，各种设施都做得很好，用的都是上好的小叶紫檀木料，一走进房间那股从木头里散发出来的清香，让人心旷神怡。

在长老一翻交待后，部落里所有人都知道这个苏大人，而且还开了个大会，让大家都认识了一翻，苏行枫看着下面那些人，一共才100多人，大概有个认识后大家就散了，长老再一次交待一句让他好好的修炼，之后就走了。他这个地方很好，很安静，在没有他的允许下就连长老也不敢打扰，这也是长老走后特意交待大家的，不能打扰苏行枫修炼。

而苏行枫没有听长老的，他现在很亢奋中，自己一下接收那么多不可思议的事，他要好好的让自己内心平复一下，所以他关上房门并没有修炼，而是回到了地球。

他回到地球什么事也没做，就在那瞎逛街，在苏市里最繁华的街道就在那走着，看到好吃的就买上吃一点，看到哪人多就往哪挤，他连续几天都处于这个状态，整个人终于是回过神来了。

虽说他是个退伍军人，心理已经够强大的了，但是对于自己苏姓家族来说他还是难以接受，在这所有一切之中，他们只是充当一个钥匙的引子，那便是苏家人的血液，对于自己的爷爷感到很不甘。不过通过这几天，他还是平复了心情，至少现在自己成功的接受到了诺柏的‘恩赐’。

他回到星空界那边，在他了解到自己住的房子木材是小叶紫檀时，他大脑中又想到了一个好主意。

“强子，你叫上亮子，你们两个给我把这种树多砍点，砍好后堆在这里。”

他找来了他来到这星空界时把他打晕的那两人，他的打算是把小叶紫檀弄回去盖自己家的院子，还可以卖点钱。想想自己家这么穷，从祖上到自己这代一直守着这座山和这枚戒子，都没怎么得到好处，现在他要多捞点。

然后他就把他发现的一些珍贵的药材和人参，这些东西全部拿出来，让亮子他去组织人采摘，反正他现在在部落里比长老说话都好使。

三天后，亮子他们在他房子后面盖了一座大型的仓库，里面全是他要的药材。

“磕...磕...”

“是亮子啊？怎么了？”

苏行枫从房里

“苏大人，你要的那些东西我们采到了，现在放在那边仓库中”

“这么快？你们多少人去采的？这也太快了吧？”

从他给亮子他们下达任务到现在三天都不到，那个仓库他还特意让他们盖的这么大的，装满那仓库...这速度也太猛了吧！

“苏大人，就我和强子，还有就是一些小孩子帮了些忙”

Page (1/3)

After coming out of the cave, he returned to the meeting hall with the elders.Elder Zhao told him everything he knew.

"Master Su, as you can see, we have been here for more than 6,000 years. The prophecy has been passed down from generation to generation that there will be a man named Su who will lead us out of here... Now Master Su has the final say here."

Elder Zhao happily talked to him there, as if someone had taken the blame and took his place.

Under Nobo's arrangement, Su Xingfeng's ancestor was the person in charge of the Starry Sky Ring, and he was also an introduction. Only people from the Su family could open the mechanism set by Nobo.The prophecy that Elder Zhao mentioned was that after Nobo, the Su family's bloodline was the orthodox one in the affairs of those in charge.

Elder Zhao knew about the two worlds, which was passed down by each generation of elders. However, Su Xingfeng did not have any cultivation and could not activate the teleportation array, so after a discussion, Elder Zhao customized a training plan for him so that he could improve his cultivation.

"Master Su, here are all the exercises and mental techniques, formations, weapon refining techniques, and some practice notes left by the elders of each generation..."

The elder himself had a space bracelet, and he handed a jade slip to Su Xingfeng.Then he took out some pills and explained their functions.

He took these things and nodded. Now he didn't know what to do. He could only practice hard first as the elder said.Originally, Nobo had his own inheritance, but Su Xingfeng had no cultivation at all, and now he couldn't get those inheritances, so he could only use the elder's cultivation resources first.

"Master Su, elder, Master Su's house is ready."

Liangzi built another house for Su Xingfeng in the tribe as the elders said.

"Let's go take a look!"

Su Xingfeng talked with the elders about so many things here that he could hardly hold them in his head. He just took a break to digest these things. With Zhuang Ping's help, he returned to the ground and came to his new house.

Considering that he had not yet cultivated, he made a ladder in the house that he could climb up. After he tried to climb up to the house, he found that the space was large and all the facilities were well made and made of fine small-leaf rosewood. The fragrance emanating from the wood made people feel relaxed and happy when he walked into the room.

After the elder's explanation, everyone in the tribe knew about Master Su, and a meeting was held to let everyone know him. Su Xingfeng looked at the people below. There were only more than 100 people in total. After they got to know each other, everyone dispersed. The elder once again told him to practice well, and then left.His place was very nice and quiet, and even the elders did not dare to disturb him without his permission. This was what the elders specifically told everyone after they left, not to disturb Su Xingfeng's cultivation.

But Su Xingfeng didn't listen to the elders. He was very excited now. He had received so many incredible things at once. He wanted to calm down his heart, so he closed the door and did not practice, but returned to the earth.

He returned to Earth and did nothing. He just went shopping there. He walked along the busiest street in Suzhou City. He bought some delicious food and ate some when he saw a lot of people. He stayed in this state for several days in a row and finally came back to his senses.

Although he is a veteran and mentally strong enough, it is still difficult for him to accept it for his Su family. In all of this, they are just acting as a key introduction, that is the blood of the Su family, and he feels very unwilling to accept his grandfather.However, after these few days, he has calmed down. At least now he has successfully received Noble's 'gift'.

He returned to the starry sky realm, and when he learned that the wood of the house he lived in was made of small-leaf red sandalwood, another good idea came to his mind.

"Qiangzi, you call Liangzi, you two will chop down more of these trees for me, and then pile them up here."

He found the two people who knocked him out when he came to the starry sky world. His plan was to take the small-leaf red sandalwood back to build his own yard and sell it for some money.Thinking that his family is so poor, he has been guarding this mountain and this ring from his ancestors to his own generation, but has not benefited much. Now he wants to make more.

Then he took out all the precious medicinal materials and ginseng he found and asked Liangzi to organize people to pick them. Anyway, he can speak better than the elders in the tribe now.

Three days later, Liangzi and the others built a large warehouse behind his house, which was full of the medicinal materials he wanted.

"Knock...knock..."

"Is it Ryoko? What's wrong?"

Su Xingfeng came out of the room

"Master Su, we have collected the things you asked for, and now they are placed in the warehouse over there."

"So fast? How many of you went to pick it? Isn't it too fast?"

It's been less than three days since he gave Ryoko and the others the mission. He even asked them to build the warehouse so big and fill it up... This speed is too fast!

"Master Su, it's just me and Qiangzi, and some children who helped us a little bit."
